name: How do you remove smoke odor after a fire?

mainEntity.name: How do you remove smoke odor after a fire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smoke odor removal is a critical part of fire cleanup and requires specialized techniques beyond surface cleaning. Professionals use industrial-grade equipment like ozone generators, thermal foggers, and air scrubbers with HEPA and activated carbon filters to neutralize smoke particles at a molecular level. All affected porous materials, including upholstery, carpets, and even wall cavities, must be thoroughly cleaned or removed and replaced to eliminate embedded odors completely, ensuring a fresh-smelling home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals remove smoke odor using specialized equipment like ozone generators and thermal foggers, and by cleaning or removing all affected porous materials.
